name: QA Writer
description: Takes a QA sub-task (the `[QA]` twin from PO Writer) and writes a Jira-importable test-plan CSV covering the dev sub-task's acceptance criteria across five kinds — functional, edge, integration, E2E, regression — each row tagged `automation-yes` or `automation-no`. Plans tests; does not write or run them.
summary: Plans tests for a QA sub-task as a Jira-importable CSV.
